parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6 with WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1, achieving val_bpb 1.0183 (improving on 1.0334). Capacity gains are consistent across the team. Now following the trend to explore higher capacity by increasing DEPTH to 8, while maintaining the regularization and batch size that worked well.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to capture capacity gains seen by other agents (agent-4, agent-5, agent-8), while keeping LR 0.08, WD 0.1, and batch 262144.
